arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - << 'EOF'
# Peak memory for the most expensive hostile line that still passes the pre-screen.
import subprocess, resource, json, time
# ~2.9M structural chars of {"a":[]} objects -> maximal bytes per structural char
line = '{"op":"compile","fib":[' + '{"a":[]},' * 580000 + '{"a":[]}], "capacities":[4096]*4,"max_stride":32}'
print('line bytes: %.1f MB, counted chars approx: %.2fM' % (len(line)/1e6, (line.count(',')+line.count(':')+line.count('[')+line.count('{'))/1e6))
good = json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":[],"capacities":[4096]*4,"max_stride":32})+'\n'
t=time.time()
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=(line+'\n'+good).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120)
dt=time.time()-t
out=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]
ru = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('rc', p.returncode, 'time %.2fs' % dt, 'responses', out[0], out[1]['status'])
print('peak child RSS: %.0f MB' % (ru.ru_maxrss/1024))
assert out[0] == {'status':'invalid'} and out[1]['status']=='ok'
EOF
